test_objective: Check if you update a context source registration subscription, a CsourceNotification will be sent with all currently matching context source registrations
keywords: Receive cSourceNotification For Newly Matching Context Source Registrations
Create Initial Context Source Registrations And Context Source Registration Subscription
Delete Created Context Source Registrations And Context Source Registration Subscription

test_cases.name: 047_16_01 MatchFirstContextSourceRegistration
test_cases.doc: Check if you update a context source registration subscription, a CsourceNotification will be sent with all currently matching context source registrations
test_cases.setup: Create Initial Context Source Registrations And Context Source Registration Subscription
test_cases.teardown: Delete Created Context Source Registrations And Context Source Registration Subscription
test_cases.template: Receive cSourceNotification For Newly Matching Context Source Registrations
test_cases.then:
then {
    the client at '${endpoint}' receives a valid Notification containing:
        Notification received Waiting for Notification and validate it and
    Query Parameter: expected_subscription_id set to 'subscription_id' and
    Query Parameter: expected_context_source_registration_ids set to '${first_context_source_registration_id}' and
    Query Parameter: expected_trigger_reason set to 'newlyMatching' and
    Query Parameter: expected_notification_data_entities set to '${EMPTY}' and
    Query Parameter: timeout set to '5'
}
